Score 3, confirmation_state CONFIRMED. a11y_glitch_user's missing_name mode produces an empty <h2> heading and an empty image alt attribute -- a named, tool-specific (axe-core) detectable violation with a fully-enumerated, known outcome set.

Auditor applied the tie-break rule (provisional_score=3, confirmed_score=2, confirmation_state null). The stated unresolved verification requirement (evidence.csv, SUT01-EV-0020 notes; audit.md section 3) is stated in concrete, closeable terms -- 'a mechanism that establishes a specifically visual perturbation, or an EXECUTION_VERIFIED screenshot-diff demonstrating this data condition produces a stable, tool-detectable visual difference against a baseline' -- which is exactly the kind of genuine, closeable verification gap the tie-break rule's second bullet contemplates, not plausibility or vendor reputation. The narrower basis for DISPUTED here is that step 3's doubt itself turns on an additional criterion this auditor applied -- that the mechanism must be one 'the SUT itself frames or exposes as a visual-testing condition as such', not merely a data condition that happens to render visibly differently -- and that criterion does not appear in protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md's own text (the rubric's Score 3 definition and its 'controlled visual condition' example impose no such framing requirement). SUT-03's image_not_loading_user forcing every product thumbnail to fail to render (SUT03-EV-0021) and SUT-02's visual_user/visual@example.com deterministic image substitution (SUT02-EV-0016, SUT02-EV-0017) are cited here not as proof this cell is wrong, but as evidence that the framing criterion is not uniformly read into the rubric across this campaign's independent audits -- both were scored Score 3 CONFIRMED without any such framing test being applied to a structurally similar account-gated, forced-image mechanism. Flagged DISPUTED for human decision on a single, narrow question: whether 'the SUT itself frames the mechanism as a visual-testing condition' is part of Decision procedure step 3 under protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md, or an additional, unwritten requirement. confirmed_score=2 is fully supported by the evidence on record either way and is not asserted here to be an undercount; it remains the recorded value pending that decision.
